title: etlingera calophrys
intro: Etlingera calophrys, commonly known as the Bunga Terompet, is a species of flowering plant in the ginger family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and fever. The health benefits of Etlingera calophrys include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system, while its therapeutic actions include antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Etlingera calophrys include gingerols, shogaols, and other bioactive compounds that have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
